concerns.text: Plan element Phase 0.3 ('If any required raw-count source remains unavailable, update spec.md to a Case-Study mode and mark FR-001 as Partially Met — Required before any downstream task') has NO matching task. T003 implements the abort/availability logic but no task performs the spec.md update the plan declares as a prerequisite, so this plan element is uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs plan.md Phase 3 Statistical Modeling
concerns.text: Plan states 'Shapiro-Wilk for normality; if violated, use Kruskal-Wallis'. T007 only 'Runs Shapiro-Wilk on residuals and logs violations' — the Kruskal-Wallis fallback model has no implementing task, leaving a plan element uncovered.

Three active contracts have no task producing a conforming artifact: (a) metrics.schema.yaml (metrics array with metric_type/value/generated_at) — T006 writes fidelity_results.csv against fidelity_results.schema.yaml instead; (b) model_output_schema.schema.yaml (term/coef/f_statistic/is_descriptive_mode) — T007's statistical_result.json targets only statistical_result.schema.yaml; (c) dataset_schema.schema.yaml (metadata/counts/cell_labels/gene_names) — no task validates or emits this structure. Either tasks must cover these contracts or the contracts must be retired; currently they are dead plan elements.

FR-002 requires Trustworthiness 'calculated [deferred] randomly sampled cell pairs to ensure computational feasibility'. T004 computes trustworthiness on the full sampled cell set with no pair-sampling mechanism task; the deferred computational-feasibility mechanism named by the FR has no covering task that even states how it will be resolved or measured.
